Appellant :- Himanshu
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Appellant :- Vipin Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Sanjay Mishra

Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned AGA for opposite party no.1 and Sri Nitin Kumar,
Advocate holding brief of Sri Sanjay Mishra, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material placed on record.

The present criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been filed by the appellant to set aside the impugned order dated 26.04.2023 whereby the Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Etawah has rejected the bail application of the appellant moved by him in Case Crime No. 131 of 2022, under Sections 376, 306, 504, 506 of IPC,
and Section 3(1) (R.S.), 3(2)5a, 3(2)5 of SC/ST Act, Police Station Jaswant Nagar, District Etawah.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that against the rejection order passed by the trial Court Criminal Appeal No. 4946 of 2022 was moved by the appellant which was rejected vide order dated 09.02.2023.

It is submitted that some aspects were considered such as the deceased remained with the appellant for two months as stated by prosecution witness PW-1 Mohini, is not mentioned in the Himanshu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159790316/
1 FIR.

entities.text: Himanshu vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the first information report of the incident was lodged after one month and four days against seven persons while charge sheet has only been filed against the appellant.
It reflects that the version of the prosecution is not reliable.

No recovery of any mobile is made out of the possession of appellant and the appellant was never seen together with the deceased Varsha @
Vandana.
It is a case of malicious prosecution under the provisions of S.C./S.T. Act.
Applicant is languishing in jail since 12.05.2022 having no criminal history.
In case, the appellant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. assisted by learned counsel for the informant has supported the order passed by the Sessions court and vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the appellant and submits that all aspects of the matter have already been considered while deciding the first appeal of the appellant.

So far as the statement of PW-1 Mohini is concerned, her examination in chief has been recorded and her cross examination is under process, therefore, no conclusion can be drawn at this stage on the basis of incomplete evidence.
It appears from the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and from perusal of material on record that the court below has properly considered the case of the appellant.
Hence, in view of above consideration, the order of rejection of bail passed by the court below dated 26.04.2023 is affirmed.

Having considered the submissions of the parties noted above, finding no force in the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant; without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that the appellant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail and the appeal deserves to be dismissed.
The criminal appeal is dismissed.
The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously in accordance with law, if there is no other legal impediment.

It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The trial court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything said in this order.
Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Mohit  Himanshu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159790316/
